method: Primary statutory/institutional authority review. Shared legislation can settle the legal powers of a named class of first-level bodies; it does not establish current website ownership, media playback or permission. Municipalities remain excluded even where they have similar powers.

decisions.assessment: Official Assembly explanation establishes scrutiny, consultation, recommendations and conditional budget/strategy amendment or rejection, not substantive general regional lawmaking. The published institutional review explicitly distinguishes its lack of legislative powers. Exclude under the agreed legislative-authority bar; working webcasts do not change eligibility.
decisions.version_note: Current official role explanation corroborates the earlier express no-legislative-powers review; budget and scrutiny alone are insufficient.

decisions.assessment: RA7160 section468 expressly identifies the Sangguniang Panlalawigan as the provincial legislative body with ordinances, appropriations, revenue/regulatory powers and provincial-ordinance penalties. This is a first-level province, not a municipal/barangay council. National-law limits do not negate the substantive regional authority under the same rule used for Japanese and Dutch ordinances.
